items.title: Sun Wheel Medallion DXF Panel with Chain-Link Border Frame
items.description: A radiating sun-wheel medallion sits at the heart of the panel, surrounded by a grid of arched cells and a beaded chain-link border on all four sides. The layered composition gives a stained-glass, architectural feel ideal for gates and room dividers.

items.title: Greek Key Medallion Abstract Teardrop Mesh Screen
items.description: A complex architectural panel featuring a central circular wheel bound by a traditional interlocking Greek key border. The entire outer background is filled with a dense, repeating mesh of stylized interlocking teardrops and leaf vectors.

items.title: Natural Birch Forest Tree Trunk Silhouette Fretwork Vector
items.description: A refreshing, nature-inspired decorative panel showcasing a continuous silhouette of tall birch trees with delicate branches and gently falling leaves. The vertical alignment of the trunks provides natural structural stability while creating an organic, open-air atmosphere.
